annotations.title: Correct the briefing in plain words

description: Tell the briefing what was wrong with it, in plain language — "too much crypto and not enough on the EU regulation", "keep it shorter", "explain the technical parts more simply", "follow this story". An AI editor reads the note against the actual briefing and turns it into concrete adjustments: topic preferences, settings, deep-dive requests. This is the main way a person retunes their news feed by talking.

briefing_id.description: Which briefing the note refers to. Omit for the latest.

entry_id.description: Optional: the specific story the note is about (entry id from get_briefing)

note.description: What was wrong or what they want changed, in their own words
